operating_notes.text: Pharma packaging grew by 210% in FY26 to ₹34.4 Cr from ₹11 Cr in FY25
Paints segment grew by 13.4% in FY26, with ABG contributing significantly
Thin wall packaging grew by 15.4% in FY26, with Panipat facility contributing to growth
Raw material cost increased from ₹97/kg in Q4FY26 to ₹130/kg in Q1FY27 due to war situation
Working capital increased to ₹125 Cr from ₹110-112 Cr at end of March due to higher raw material costs
